"""Repro for TASK.md: FK to non-numeric PK loses value when pk set after assignment."""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
)
django.setup()

from django.db import models, transaction, connection


class Product(models.Model):
    sku = models.CharField(primary_key=True, max_length=50)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"


class Order(models.Model):
    product = models.ForeignKey(Product, on_delete=models.CASCADE)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"


with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(Product)
    se.create_model(Order)

# Scenario A (the bug): pk set AFTER assignment to parent
try:
    with transaction.atomic():
        order = Order()
        order.product = Product()
        order.product.sku = "foo"
        order.product.save()
        order.save()
        stale = Order.objects.filter(product_id="").exists()
        found = Order.objects.filter(product=order.product).exists()
        print("A: product_id=%r  filter(product_id='')=%s  filter(product=... )=%s"
              % (Order.objects.get(pk=order.pk).product_id, stale, found))
        print("A: COMMIT OK")
except Exception as e:
    print("A: commit failed:", type(e).__name__, e)

# Scenario B (control): pk set before assignment
with transaction.atomic():
    order = Order()
    order.product = Product(sku="bar")
    order.product.save()
    order.save()
    print("B: product_id=%r" % Order.objects.get(pk=order.pk).product_id)

# Scenario C (control): numeric pk, set after assignment
class Category(models.Model):
    code = models.CharField(primary_key=True, max_length=10)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"


class Item(models.Model):
    category = models.ForeignKey(Category, on_delete=models.CASCADE)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"


with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(Category)
    se.create_model(Item)

with transaction.atomic():
    item = Item()
    item.category = Category()
    item.category.code = "x1"
    item.category.save()
    item.save()
    print("C: category_id=%r" % Item.objects.get(pk=item.pk).category_id)
